name: Kjeldorans
description: People of Kjeldor, whose lands fall to the sea.

description_citations.text: "The Shattered Alliance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The aesthir breed that could survive cold weather goes extinct after the Ice Age, but Kjeldorans breed a warm-weather variant.
timeline.quote: a breed that could survive warmer weather was bred by Kjeldorans and exists to the modern day.

citation.text: "Bird", section "Aesthir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Jaya meet Lovisa's Balduvians, who say the Kjeldorans are raiding them, and Jaya takes Lim-Dul's finger from a shaman.
timeline.quote: Jaya sees one of the Balduvian shamans carrying Lim-Dûl's finger as a talisman
